title: Puromycin: initial velocity of an enzymatic reaction versus substrate concentration (treated and untreated cells)
license: Factual data from a 1974 thesis, reproduced in Bates & Watts (1988) and in R 'datasets'; verify reuse terms for publication.
description: Galactosyltransferase reaction velocity (radioactive counts per minute per minute) against substrate concentration (ppm), measured on cells treated with Puromycin and on untreated cells; duplicate measurements at each concentration (one missing untreated point at 1.10 ppm).

conditions.note: As reported by the source; temperature and buffer are not given in the reproduced table.

uncertainty.note: No stated measurement uncertainty; duplicates allow a pooled replicate standard deviation to be estimated.

applicability: Michaelis–Menten fitting exercises and validation; not a general property of the enzyme.
